dev_compose.stdout_sample:
name: chatbot2
services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: D:\chatbot2
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: huit_chatbot_backend
    depends_on:
      mongo:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: change_this_to_a_strong_password_in_production
      ADMIN_TOKEN: change_this_to_a_long_random_secret_token_in_production
      ADMIN_USERNAME: admin_huit

prod_compose.stdout_sample:
name: chatbot2
services:
  backend:
    build:
      context: D:\chatbot2
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    container_name: huit_chatbot_backend_prod
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: 2
          memory: "2147483648"
        reservations:
          cpus: 0.5
          memory: "536870912"
    environment:
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: test_admin_password_secure_123
